name: Erin Michelle Dalton

public.text:
I’m Erin Dalton, 44, and I work as an administrative coordinator at a community health clinic in Portland. My top interests are: 1) reading nonfiction and narrative journalism, 2) public health and practical policy, 3) cooking simple, healthful meals, 4) travel planning and historically rich cities, 5) local news and a few podcasts, 6) small music shows, 7) community health and food-drive volunteering, 8) neighborhood and transit issues, 9) editing and writing, and 10) gardening herbs on my balcony.

For ready-to-drink bottled gazpacho, I’d give my propensity to purchase a 3 out of 5. I like the idea of a convenient vegetable-based option, but cold blended soup isn’t a usual choice for me. I’d probably look at the ingredients and price before deciding whether to try it.

justification: She likes the idea of a convenient vegetable-based option, but cold blended soup isn’t a usual choice for her; she would check the ingredients and price before deciding whether to try it.
